title: SWF: RemoveObject2 for deleted display objects
description: When a display object is present in frame N but absent from frame N+1, emit RemoveObject2 (tag 28) for its depth in the SWF frame loop. Check packages/swf/src/compile.ts — search for 'RemoveObject2' or tag 28. If not implemented: track which depths were placed in the previous frame, compare to current frame, emit RemoveObject2 for depths that disappeared. Add unit tests.
